title: Izwi Elabiza Ukulunga
intro: Ezweni lasendulo lakwaMidiyani, lapho ukuhweba kwakuchuma khona futhi izinqola zamahhashi zazihamba ogwadule olukhulu, kwavela umprofethi ka-Allah phakathi kwabantu ababephambukile endleleni yobulungiswa. Le nceku ka-Allah yathunyelwa nomsebenzi waphezulu owawuzovivinya ukholo lomphakathi wonke. Ngokuvivinywa kokubekezela nokuphikelela, lo mphefumulo wama waqina ekuletheni isixwayiso esasizozwakala emlandweni. Ungakwazi yini ukuxazulula imfihlakalo yalesi sithunywa esiqinile?
clues: Ngakhethwa ngu-Allah ukuba ngiqondise abantu ababekhohliwe izimiso zokulunga nokwethembeka ekusebenzelaneni kwabo.
Ngithumele umyalezo othi umphakathi wami awukhulekeli muntu ngaphandle kuka-Allah futhi ukhulume iqiniso kuzo zonke izindaba.
Ngixwayise ngokukhethekile ngomkhuba okhohlakele wokudla ingcebo ngezindlela ezingekho emthethweni futhi ngagcizelela ukubaluleka kwezisindo nezilinganiso ezifanele.
Abantu bami basabela ezixwayisweni zami ngokungihleka usulu, besongela ukungixosha ezweni labo uma ngiqhubeka nomyalezo wami.
Ngahlala ngiqinile emsebenzini wami naphezu kobutha babo, ngimemezela ukuthi umvuzo wami uku-Allah kuphela.
Abantu bami babanjwa yisijeziso esibi kakhulu kuyilapho mina ngisindiswa ngesihe seNkosi yami, njengoba umsebenzi wami wawusufeziwe.
